When the bill came my boyfriend realized that he didn’t have his wallet. No problem at all. Of course I’d cover his portion. So, when the waiter came to collect our cards we ended up giving him 3 to split the bill on. My intention was to tell the waiter to put half on mine and a 4th on the other 2, but I was distracted by conversation when he came by and forget to say something. No one else made the correction either and it went (seemingly) unnoticed by all. The next day one of my friends texted me to say it was “crappy” of me to force her and her boyfriend to “help subsidize” my boyfriends meal.
